note: The Commercial Bank of Kuwait's statement of its fees and commissions as at August 2026, approved by the Central Bank of Kuwait: its account commissions for individuals charge nothing for keeping a current account (the 2 dinars a month below 200 dinars is for its prize accounts, and the minimum-average-balance charges on current accounts are for non-individuals).

sources.title: Commercial Bank of Kuwait, List of Fees and Commissions (as at August 2026)
sources.said: Accounts Commissions ... Commission on minimum balance of prizes given accounts ... Balance which falls below KD 200 ... KD 2.000 per month ... Fees & Commissions for non Individuals ... Average balance which falls below 100 KD for non-individual (Equivalent for foreign currencies) ... Statement of Tariffs and Commissions collected by Commercial Bank of Kuwait against banking services offered to customers as at August 2026 - approved by Central Bank.
